metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully starred all 2 emails in Bills folder using Ctrl+A to select all, then right-click > Mark > Add Star.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate to local folders, select all emails, apply starred flag; can also create new local folders via right-click on Local Folders.
metadata.explanation: Chains the original starring task with a folder-creation objective. Evaluator checks (1) all Bills emails have starred bit (0x0004) in X-Mozilla-Status via mbox read, (2) Receipts.msf index file exists in the Local Folders directory indicating folder creation.

scoring_breakdown.all_starred: 0.5 - All Bills emails have X-Mozilla-Status flagged bit (0x0004) set
scoring_breakdown.receipts_folder_exists: 0.5 - Receipts.msf index file found in Local Folders directory

llm_judge_reasons: The getter correctly parses Thunderbird mbox format by splitting on 'From - ' separator, which is the standard delimiter used by Thunderbird for local folder mbox files.
The starred bit check (0x0004 in X-Mozilla-Status) is the correct Thunderbird flag for starred/flagged messages.
Deleted messages (0x0008 bit) are correctly excluded from the starred check, preventing false negatives.

The Receipts folder check via Receipts.msf existence is a valid and reliable indicator: Thunderbird writes the .msf index file when a local folder is created, and the postconfig kills Thunderbird before verification ensuring disk flush.
Partial credit scoring (0.5 for starred + 0.5 for folder creation) correctly covers both sub-goals of the chained instruction.
Negative-control resistance is adequate: the initial state has no starred emails and no Receipts folder, so a do-nothing agent scores 0.0.
The hardcoded Thunderbird profile path (t5q2a5hp.default-release) is deterministic given the fixed downloaded tarball used in setup.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: The Receipts.msf check is indirect — also checking for a 'Receipts' mbox file or directory would provide stronger confirmation of folder creation, though .msf alone is sufficient in practice.

Minor: If the Bills mbox file cannot be read (file_bytes is None/empty), all_starred defaults to False without logging — adding a diagnostic field like 'mbox_read_error' would help distinguish empty folder from getter failure.
